title: Doozy Vape Co Berry Blast E-Liquid 10ml
description: Juicy strawberry meets tangy raspberry, with a sumptuously sweet syrup flavour given an icy cool hit on the exhale. As mouth-watering as it is refreshing. The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, 30% Propylene Glycol formula makes this eliquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
